task_meta.title: Harden a CSV importer against bad rows

claim_text:
I've hardened the importer. A bad row now produces one error with the line it starts on and is skipped, and the rest of the file still imports. All 21 tests pass with `dotnet run --project tests`: the original 4 and 17 new ones.

**What was breaking it:**
- **Exceptions:** `int.P
digest: Read 3 files (2 before its first edit), made 4 edits, ran tests 8 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
